1_gt_applied_share_of_scored_duration_pc.basis: Bach chorales use applied dominants regularly but briefly; typical annotation corpora put secondary functions in the single-digit percent range of time.

2_applied_share_of_root_disagree_duratio.basis: Applied chords are enriched among disagreements: reading V/x as the local-key function mis-roots by a fifth; but most root disagreement has other causes (segmentation, symmetric sonorities, key errors).

3_applied_share_of_root_agree_rn_disagre.basis: When we name the right root under the wrong degree (V/V heard as II), the pair lands in key_disagree; applied labels should be a visible but minority slice of that bucket.

4_fifth_offset_share_among_applied_root_.basis: The canonical failure reads V/Y as a chord of the local key: GT roots V-of-Y, we root Y or the local V, both a fifth away; other offsets (thirds, semitone leading-tone readings of viio/x) take the rest.
